title: 第15章 红云苏醒欲收徒元始惊现金鳌岛第16章 阐教金仙颠是非两圣对峙引争议
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
“你是何人？”
林镜手中的九九散魄葫芦之中传出了一声苍老的询问声！
“卧槽！有鬼！”
林镜还沉浸在自己的思考之中，被突然吓了一跳，本能反应一下子就把手中的九九散魄葫芦丢了出去！
九九散魄葫芦在地上滚了几圈，然后才慢悠悠飘了起来！
“哎呀呀！现在的小辈可真不讲礼貌，偷袭我这个只剩一点残魂的老人家……”
林镜这时才反应过来，他当时拿到九九散魄葫芦时，似乎还有意外发现！
那就是在葫芦之中，还存在一个沉睡的残魂！
“红云前辈？是您吗？”
林镜小心翼翼的开口询问道！
九九散魄葫芦兴奋的转了一个圈，那苍老的声音再次传出！
“哟！没想到你小子还能猜出我是谁，没错，我就是紫霄宫中三千客，蒲团座次仅次于三清和女娲的红云道人！”
林镜听着这个自我介绍一脸黑线！
大哥，你知不知道你现在这个凄惨的下场就是因为这件事才造成的啊！怎么还炫耀起来了？
你要是乖乖坐着那里也就算了，关键是最后还让了出去，不仅圣位没了，连小命都不保！
“在下林镜，见过红云前辈！”
心里吐槽归吐槽，林镜还是乖乖的行礼！
而且之前系统检测红云道人不是虚弱的残魂，而且在沉睡吗？
为什么现在苏醒过来了，听起来似乎恢复的不错啊！
【叮！因为宿主将九九散魄葫芦置于体内，混沌始源镜自主修复了一部分红云道人的魂魄，目前已经可以正常交流了！】

啊？林镜没想到自己本体竟然这么厉害，这才过去半天时间，就将虚弱至极的红云残魂恢复到可以正常交流的地步了！
这要是在他体内待上几天，那岂不是就完全恢复了？
位于九九散魄葫芦之中的红云道人，看着眼前完全没有被震惊的林镜，竟然还在分神想其他事情！
顿时不满起来，他可是乃是先天第一朵红云得道，在洪荒之中也算得上是大能级别的了！
只是没想到因为种种原因，被鲲鹏妖师算计，这才最终不幸殒命！
好在虽然他一直没能通过鸿蒙紫气像三清女娲一样成就圣人之位
，这些年也是研究了不少心得！
这才让他在鲲鹏等众妖的围攻中侥幸假死脱身，虽然只剩下一丝残魂，但是却骗过了鲲鹏！
而且九九散魄葫芦和鸿蒙紫气也保留了下来！
在陷入沉睡的最后时刻，他拼尽全力借用鸿蒙紫气之力截取了一片混沌将自己和九九散魄葫芦包裹其中！
不过因此鸿蒙紫气也消失不见，不过对于他来说能够活下来已经相当不错了！
content_en:
"Who are you?"
An old questioning voice came from the Jiujiu Sanso gourd in Lin Jing's hand!
"Damn it! There's a ghost!"
Lin Jing was still immersed in his own thoughts when he was suddenly startled. His instinctive reaction was to throw out the Nine-Nine Soul Gourd in his hand!
The Jiujiu Soul Gourd rolled on the ground a few times, and then slowly floated up!
"Oh my! The juniors nowadays are so rude, sneaking up on me, an old man with only a little bit of his soul left..."
Only then did Lin Jing realize that when he got the Nine-Nine Soul Gourd, he seemed to have made an unexpected discovery!
That is, there is still a sleeping remnant soul in the gourd!
"Senior Hongyun? Is that you?"
Lin Jing asked cautiously!
Jiujiu Sanso Gourd turned around excitedly, and the old voice came out again!
"Oh! I didn't expect you kid to guess who I am. Yes, I am Taoist Hongyun who has three thousand guests in the Zixiao Palace. The futon seats are second only to Sanqing and Nuwa!"
Lin Jing had a dark look on his face when he heard this self-introduction!
Brother, do you know that your current miserable ending is caused by this incident? Why are you still showing off?
It's okay if you just sit there obediently. The key is that if you give in in the end, not only will your holy position be lost, but your life will also be at risk!
"Lin Jing, I have met Senior Hongyun!"
Even though he was complaining in his heart, Lin Jing still bowed obediently!
Moreover, the system previously detected that Taoist Hongyun was not a weak remnant soul and was sleeping?
Why are you awake now? It sounds like you are recovering well!
【bite! Because the host placed the Jiujiu Sansoul Gourd in his body, the Chaos Origin Mirror independently repaired part of Taoist Hongyun's soul, and he can now communicate normally! 】
ah? Lin Jing did not expect that his own body would be so powerful. In just half a day, he had restored the extremely weak Hongyun Remnant Soul to the point where he could communicate normally!
If it stayed in his body for a few days, wouldn't it mean that he would be fully recovered?
Taoist Hongyun, who was in the Jiujiu Soul Gourd, looked at Lin Jing, who was not shocked at all, and was still distracted by other things!
He suddenly became dissatisfied. He was the first innate red cloud to attain enlightenment, and he could be regarded as a powerful person in the ancient world!
I just didn’t expect that due to various reasons, I was plotted by Demon Master Kunpeng, and that’s why I ended up unfortunately dying!
Fortunately, although he has never been able to achieve the status of a saint like Nuwa of the Sanqing Dynasty through the Hongmeng Purple Qi
, I have gained a lot of research experience over the years!
This allowed him to luckily escape from the siege of Kunpeng and other monsters by feigning death. Although he only had a trace of his soul left, he was able to deceive Kunpeng!
Moreover, the Nine-Nine Soul Gourd and Hongmeng Purple Qi have also been retained!
At the last moment when he fell into a deep sleep, he tried his best to borrow the power of Hongmeng Purple Qi to intercept a piece of chaos and wrap himself and the Jiujiu Sanso Gourd in it!
However, the Hongmeng Purple Qi also disappeared, but for him, being able to survive is quite good!
